title: Alert / Trigger Event
description: Standardized format for each triggered alert in the monitoring system. Supports the 15 defined trigger conditions, 4-tier alert levels, and push throttling rules.

trigger_id.description: Trigger condition ID (1-15 are defined triggers; 16-20 reserved for system health triggers)

level.description: Alert severity level. red=action, orange=prepare, yellow=watch, blue=info, green=opportunity

current_value.description: Current value of the monitored metric

threshold.description: The threshold value that was crossed

comparison.description: Whether current value is above or below the threshold

deterioration_pct.description: How much worse since last alert (for repeat filtering). Positive = worsening.

raw_data.description: Supporting data points that provide context for this alert

recommended_action.description: Specific, actionable recommendation. Must not be empty. Per push throttling rules: no alerts without actionable content.

time_slot.description: Time slot classification for push routing

throttling.description: Push throttling metadata per monitoring rules

repeat_allowed_24h.description: Can this alert repeat within 24h? (Only if deterioration >20%)

max_daily_push.description: Max pushes per day for this level (yellow: 1, others: unbounded)

same_trigger_last_alert.description: Timestamp of last alert for this same trigger

push_now.description: Based on time-slot + level + throttling, should this alert be pushed now?

falsification.description: Conditions that would void or downgrade this alert

related_alerts.description: Other currently active alerts related to this one
